question.text: The moment of inertia of a circular ring of mass $M$ and diameter r about a tangential axis lying in the plane of the ring is :

solution.text:
Diameter is given as R.
$\begin{aligned}
& \therefore \text { Radius }=\mathrm{R} / 2 \\ & \mathrm{I}_{\text {tan gent }}=\frac{3}{2} \mathrm{~m}\left(\frac{\mathrm{R}}{2}\right)^2=\frac{3}{8} \mathrm{mR}^2
\end{aligned}$
